Caline Caline DCP Dual Effects series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by type mix/route/switch noise gate browse by enclosure pedal Caline DCP-09 Tiger Shark - Gate/Distortion Published on December 3, 2023 Caline DCP Dual Effects series distortion noise gate pedal Information Caline Caline's DCP series is a line of dual pedals. 2 popular combo of effects in 1 unit for a very useful space saving feature. The Tigershark DCP-09 combines Caline's Bounty Hunter heavy metal pedal and their very useful noise gate in one pedal! The right channel is high gain with a choice of a more compressed classic tone as well as a toggle switch to change to a more open modern sound. But with all that distortion and gain you're going to need a noise gate. The silences the hiss all in one pedal. Perfect melding of tone and value!
